name: scsi_triangle
label: SCSI three-telescope right triangle (2021 Sep 11 layout)
sources: Horch et al. 2026, arXiv:2601.13447 (SCSI paper II), Sect. 2.1 and Table 1: Telescope 2 north of Telescope 1, Telescope 3 west of Telescope 1 (right angle at Telescope 1); 2021 Sep 11: N-S 2.454 m, E-W 2.452 m, NE-SW 3.469 m
notes: The layout changes every night (N-S 2.45-3.40 m, E-W 2.39-2.96 m); this is the night with the most data (3.34 h).
